title: NFL Draft 2026: Here Are the Best Ways to Watch the Three-Day Player Selection Event Online
summary: The NFL Draft takes place in Pittsburgh, PA starting on Thursday, April 23.
contentText:

The National Football League goes to Pittsburgh for the 2026 NFL Draft. With the Las Vegas Raiders expected to take Indiana Hoosiers quarterback and NCAA CFP National Champion Fernando Mendoza with the No. 1 pick, the three-day player selection event kicks off beginning on Thursday, Apr. 23.

The NFL Draft starts with Round 1 on Thursday, Apr. 23, with a start time of 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT, while Round 2 and Round 3 takes place on Friday, Apr. 24, at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT. To close out the event, Round 4 through Round 7 happens on Saturday, Apr. 25, at 12 p.m. ET/9 a.m. PT.

For 2026, the NFL Draft broadcasts across ABC, ESPN and NFL Network.

The NFL Draft takes place at Acrisure Stadium in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Meanwhile, Wiz Khalifa, Kane Brown and Bret Michaels perform during the 2026 NFL Draft Entertainment Series throughout the three-day event.

Sports lovers who don’t have cable or access to live television can watch the draft on platforms, such as DirecTV , which offers ABC, ESPN and NFL Network, as well hundreds of other live and on-demand channels; plus DVR, multiple device streams and much more with a five-day free trial .
